------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Jyotsna Rewal Dua, Judge
This writ petition has been filed for the grant of following substantive prayers:-
"i) By issuing writ of mandamus directing the respondents to assess the damage to
the property of the petitioner in Whether reporters of print and electronic media may
be allowed to see the order?

Yes.

1 terms of notice issued by the District Collector Annexure P-5 and Annexure P-6.
ii) By issuing writ of mandamus directing the respondents to acquire the property of the petitioner referred in Annexure P-1 in accordance with law.
iii) By issuing writ of mandamus directing the respondents .
to pay compensation to the petitioners after getting it assessed in terms of notices Annexure-P5 and Annexure-P6."
2. On 13.07.2023, Hon'ble Division Bench passed following order in the matter:-
"Having regard to notification dt. 8th June, 2020, the Committee constituted by the State Government, consisting of the Deputy Commissioner of the District Solan,
Superintending Engineer, HP PWD, Solan, Executive Engineer, Solan, Project Director, NHAI, Shimla, Sub Divisional Magistrate-CALA are suo motu impleaded as party respondents in this writ petition.

sentences.text: Learned Advocate General shall obtain instructions from the said persons/Committee as to why compensation for the damage to the land of the petitioner is not assessed by the said Committee and why only compensation for the building and structure is assessed.

Learned counsel for respondent no.5 seeks time to file objections to the status report filed by respondent no.3.
List on 31st August, 2023."
2(i).

In terms of the above order, learned Additional Advocate General was to obtain instructions from the Committee as to why compensation for the damage to the petitioner's land had not been assessed by the Committee and why only compensation for building and structure had been assessed.
On 03.10.2023, the respondents were directed to have specific instructions in terms of the above extracted order dated 13.07.2023.
The order passed on the next date .
of hearing, i.e. 02.11.2023, records learned Deputy Advocate General handing over copy of instructions dated 01.11.2023, imparted by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Solan.
2(iii).

Taking note of the facts brought on record by the respondents, vide a detailed order passed on 22.04.2024, it was observed that nothing remains to be adjudicated in the present proceedings,
though the matter was adjourned at the request of learned counsel for the petitioner.

sentences.text: By way of instant application, permission has been sought by the applicant/petitioner to place on record copy of representation alleged to have been filed by the applicant/petitioner to the Chairman-cum- Deputy Commissioner, Solan, District Solan, H.P, for assessment of damages to the property of the applicant/petitioner.

Having perused the documents vis--vis relief sought in the present petition, this Court is of the view that no prejudice, if any, shall be caused to either of the parties, if the aforesaid representation is taken on record, rather the same will help this Court to adjudicate the controversy in most effective manner.
For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed and representation proposed to be placed on record, is ordered to be taken on record.
The application stands disposed of.

Perusal of communication dated 01.11.2023, reveals that as per report dated 01.11.2023, received from the Sub Divisional Magistrate-cum-CALA, Solan, an amount of Rs.2,98,346/- is payable to the petitioner as per his share.
Apart from above, sum of Rs.7,92,694/- already stands released/disbursed as ex-gratia to the petitioner for damages to his house on 3.9.2022.

Entire amount of Rs.1,21,06,018/-
in respect of Award .
No.9/C, dated 29.09.2018 could not be released to the affected parties, including the petitioner owing to the ongoing dispute qua apportionment of the amount of compensation, which is pending in the Court of learned District Judge, Solan vide case No.23 of 2019 dated 01.07.2019.

3. I have also learned counsel on both sides.

The status report filed on the affidavit of respondent No.3- Competent Authority under Land Acquisition Act (CALA), District Solan, inter-alia, states that:-
3(i).

Land comprised in Khasra No.83/1, measuring 7 Biswas and Khasra No.84/1,
measuring 3 Biswas, in which the petitioner has his share, had already been acquired vide Award No.9/C, dated 29.09.2018.
3(ii).
The award has been sanctioned for Rs.1,21,06,018/- including the compensation of the building of co-owner.

sentences.text: As per the share of the petitioner, an amount of Rs.2,98,346/- in Khasra No.83/1 and Rs.1,29,862/- in Khasra No.84/1 is payable to him on account of acquisition of his share of land.

An amount of Rs.7,92,694/- has already been .
disbursed to the petitioner for damages to his house on 03.09.2022.

3(v). The entire amount of compensation amounting to Rs.1,21,06,018/- in respect of Award No.9/C, dated 29.09.2018, has not been released to the affected parties including the petitioner owing to the ongoing dispute qua apportionment of amount of compensation.
The share of the petitioner can be released to him only after the decision of the reference petition under Section 3H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
4. In view of the above and also taking into consideration the order already passed in the matter on 22.04.2024, nothing survives for adjudication in this petition.
The same is, therefore, closed.
The petitioner is at liberty to avail appropriate remedy for the redressal of his remaining grievances, if any, in accordance with law.
Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
